facts.fact: The Financing Agreement signed on 8 October 2020 has IDA extend a USD 140,000,000 credit for PRODIGY, whose Part 1 is to pay for the development, acquisition and implementation of a national civil registration platform (back-end, front-end and databases), civil registration transfers to communes and the operating costs of the national civil registration and identification centre.

The Financing Agreement signed on 8 October 2020 provides for the operationalization of the National Civil Registration and Identification Center (NCRIC) to manage two national civil registration and identification databases, and makes failure to adopt the NCRIC legal framework an event of suspension.
